title: Audit tables
objectives: An audit record identifies actor, tenant, action and time, and should not be silently rewritten using ordinary UPDATE or DELETE paths.
The table requires an actor and a trigger refuses both mutation operations. The acceptance contract tests that a real database rejects changes rather than trusting application conventions.
securityBoundary: A database owner or privileged administrator can disable or bypass a trigger. Real tamper-evident audit systems also require external retention, least-privilege roles and operational controls.
